title: BEiT
paper_title: BEiT: BERT Pre-Training of Image Transformers
core_mech: BEiT 的辨识点是预测外部 tokenizer 产生的离散视觉码，而非 MAE 式像素重建或普通对比学习。
core_mech_en: Pretrains Vision Transformers via BERT-style Masked Image Modeling by predicting discrete visual tokens generated by an external dVAE tokenizer.
input_desc: 原始图像，以及对其 patch 随机遮挡后的 token 序列
input_en: Raw image (for dVAE tokenizer) + block-wise masked patch sequence (for ViT encoder)
output_desc: 被遮挡位置的离散视觉 token 分布；微调时复用 Transformer 图像表示
output_en: Categorical distribution over discrete visual codes at masked positions; transferable ViT backbone

adapter.name: BEiT
adapter.mechanism: Masked patch prediction uses discrete target tokens instead of pixels.
limitations: Teaching tokenizer is fixed patch-intensity quantization, NOT the pretrained dVAE tokenizer. Demonstrates the discrete-target objective only; no claim of BEiT architecture or result equivalence.

verification.title: BEiT
verification.budget_enforcement: cooperative boundary checks; not an OS allocation limit
limitations: Teaching tokenizer is fixed patch-intensity quantization, NOT the pretrained dVAE tokenizer. Demonstrates the discrete-target objective only; no claim of BEiT architecture or result equivalence.
verification.isolation: One fresh Python process per model; sequential execution
verification.evidence_note: Original successful execution retained at its original version and date. Executable code and this dataset match the captured release; source registry metadata changed. No model was rerun by this build.

gaps: Original method has no implemented and tested local CPU adapter.
